extraction_notes: Independent re-extraction (opus) of 3 products from the 18-page VisionNav English full-line product catalog. Text-layer extraction via pdfplumber (no page images needed: every KO-level field was present as printed text; the per-page dimension drawings only repeat callouts l1/b1/h1/Wa that are already given numerically in the spec tables). Field set scoped to config/fields.json scopes '*' + 'Logistics:AGV' + 'Logistics:AGV:Forklift' (all three products classify as Forklift AGV). Units converted to the AP0 'unit' column where the datasheet's printed unit differs (notably gradient: datasheet prints degrees, AP0 expects %). Page numbers below are PDF page numbers; the catalog's own printed folio (e.g. '07-08') is given in field_sources where useful.
catalog_wide_values_caveat: The fields max_fleet_size, fleet_control_architecture, fleet_management_system, integration_capability and industries_served are NOT printed in the per-model spec tables. They come from the catalog's shared sections (p.3 'RCS (Robot Control System)' / 'SOLUTION ARCHITECTURE', p.2 company profile, p.18 'Application Fields') and therefore describe the whole VisionNav range, not these three models specifically. They are repeated identically on each product entry and each is cited to its shared page. A reviewer may prefer to import them as company-wide/base-model fan-out rather than per-product.

products.notes: PRINTED MODEL CODE: the catalog prints 'VNT20(V)-01' (page 5, folio 07-08); '(V)' denotes the vision-navigation build. — PLAUSIBILITY FLAG: lifting_height 125 mm falls below the config/plausibility.json floor for required_lifting_height (min 500 mm). The value is nonetheless correct and printed verbatim ('Fork Lift Height（h3） 125mm(4.92in)'); the plausibility floor is calibrated for tender-side rack lift heights, not for low-lift pallet jacks. No import correction needed — flagged only so a reviewer doesn't mistake it for an OCR error. — AISLE WIDTH CHOICE: the datasheet prints TWO aisle figures: 'Min. Stacking Aisle Width 2800mm' and 'Min. Turning Aisle Width 2300mm' (both for pallet 1200x1000 mm, across forks widthwise). I took the larger/worst-case stacking figure for min_aisle_width because the field is KO_IF_GT (a too-small supplier figure would wrongly admit). The 2300 mm turning aisle is recorded here for the reviewer. — NOT MAPPED (printed but no in-scope AP0 field): Minimum Turning Radius(Wa) 1900 mm (min_turning_radius exists only in scope Logistics:AGV:AMR, so it is out of scope for a Forklift AGV and was deliberately NOT written); vehicle dead weight 740 kg; fork dimensions l/e/s 1050x165x55 mm; width over forks b5 680 mm; width between forks b4 322 mm; load centre C 600 mm; lift speed 36/43 mm/s, lower speed 64/60 mm/s; reverse and turning speeds (0.6 / 0.3 m/s); Maximum Groove Width 20 mm; Maximum Step Height 10 mm; battery 24V/200Ah. — GROUND FLATNESS: p.5 prints 'Ground Flatness ±5mm/㎡' but floor_flatness_req allows only ['Standard (FM2)','High (FM1)','Very High (F-number)','None stated']; ±5 mm/m² names no standard and mapping it to an FM class would be a guess, so the field was left NULL and the raw figure is recorded here. — BATTERY TYPE: the 'Battery / Type' cell is physically EMPTY on p.5 (verified by word-coordinate inspection, not just text order) — only 'Voltage/Capacity 24V/200Ah' is filled. battery_type therefore NULL (the Q-series page 17 does state 'Lead-acid Battery', but that must not be carried over). — DELIBERATE NULLS: infrastructure_free (vision navigation is stated, but the document never states whether floor/wall modifications are required — AP0 NULL RULE requires an explicit statement); outdoor_capable (p.4 lists only 'Indoor ...' scenarios for column T and ticks 'Indoor & Outdoor Traction' only for Q, but that is a recommended-scenario matrix, not a capability exclusion — a wrong false on a KO_BOOL_REQUIRED field would disqualify); vda5050_compatible (string 'VDA 5050' does not occur in the document); safety_standard / functional_safety_level (p.3 says only 'Strictly complied with international safety design standards ... 5 level safety protection' — no ISO 3691-4, PL or SIL named); ingress_protection_rating; cleanroom_class; battery_runtime / charge_time (only 24V/200Ah given, no runtime); multi_load_compatibility; fork_spread; special_fork_option; mast_type (pallet jack has no mast); barcode_readers; trailer_loading / trailer_unloading (p.4 'Truck Loading & Unloading' is ticked only for columns P and E, not T — recorded as evidence but left null rather than false); stock_line_scanning; busbar_compatible; omnidirectional_movement; autonomous_obstacle_bypass (p.3 mentions fleet-level 'path planning, collisions avoidance', which is not the same as autonomous re-routing around an obstacle); reference_count (p.2 'more than 50 Fortune 500 companies' counts customers, not reference projects). — JUDGMENT CALLS a reviewer may want to overrule: (1) safety_coverage 'Limited 3D (e.g. waterfall)' is an allowed-value mapping of the printed sensor list (2D laser planes front/rear/side PLUS a top photoelectric + ultrasound scanner adding above-plane detection) — it is more than single-plane 2D but nothing in the document claims full 3D volumetric monitoring. (2) drop_accuracy_dep and pick_req_accuracy_dep repeat the lateral figure because the datasheet gives a single positional tolerance (±20 mm / ±100 mm) without splitting lateral vs depth. (3) load_type 'Pallet ISO' derives from the repeatedly stated 1200x1000 mm pallet; the catalog's own carrier taxonomy (nine-block / 3-base / perimeter-base pallet) has no AP0 equivalent, and 'Pallet EUR' (1200x800) is never mentioned, so it was NOT added. (4) guidance ['None'] and fleet_management_system 'Proprietary' are inferred from the absence of any rail/wire or open-interface statement plus the positive statement of vision navigation / VisionNav's own RCS.

products.notes: PRINTED MODEL CODE: 'VNT20(V)-07' (p.6, folio 09-10). Same T Series family as VNT20-01 and the same 2000 kg rated capacity, but a physically DIFFERENT unit: lighter (600 kg vs 740 kg dead weight), shorter and wider (2000x1050x2100 vs 2150x1021x1965 mm), slower (1.6 vs 2.0 m/s), lower lift (115 vs 125 mm), tighter aisles (2700/2100 vs 2800/2300 mm), longer forks (1160 vs 1050 mm). Do not treat the two as duplicates. The p.4 range-overview column 'T' carries the -07 figures. — PLAUSIBILITY FLAG: lifting_height 115 mm is below the config/plausibility.json floor of 500 mm for required_lifting_height; the value is printed verbatim and correct for a low-lift pallet jack (see the same note on VNT20-01). — AISLE WIDTH CHOICE: took 'Min. Stacking Aisle Width' 2700 mm (worst case, KO_IF_GT) over 'Min. Turning Aisle Width' 2100 mm; both are printed on p.6 for pallet 1200x1000 mm across forks widthwise. — NOT MAPPED (printed, no in-scope AP0 field): Minimum Turning Radius(Wa) 1700 mm (min_turning_radius is AMR-scope only — deliberately not written for a Forklift AGV); dead weight 600 kg; fork dimensions 1160x170x75 mm; b5 680 mm; b4 340 mm; load centre 600 mm; lift speed 40/55 mm/s, lower speed 35/35 mm/s; Maximum Groove Width 20 mm; Maximum Step Height 10 mm; battery 24V/200Ah. — GROUND FLATNESS: 'Ground Flatness ±5mm/㎡' (p.6) names no flatness standard, so floor_flatness_req left NULL rather than force-mapped to an FM class. — BATTERY TYPE: the 'Battery / Type' cell is empty on p.6 (verified by word coordinates); only Voltage/Capacity is filled → battery_type NULL. — DELIBERATE NULLS: identical set to VNT20-01 (infrastructure_free, outdoor_capable, vda5050_compatible, safety_standard, functional_safety_level, ingress_protection_rating, cleanroom_class, battery_runtime, charge_time, battery_type, battery_swap_capable, multi_load_compatibility, fork_spread, special_fork_option, mast_type, barcode_readers, trailer_loading/unloading, stock_line_scanning, busbar_compatible, omnidirectional_movement, autonomous_obstacle_bypass, multi_fleet_capable, installation_process, modification_process, min_fleet_size, typical_project_value, lead_time_weeks, reference_count, distribution_model, service_coverage) — reasons as documented on the VNT20-01 entry. — JUDGMENT CALLS: same four as VNT20-01 (safety_coverage mapping; depth accuracies repeating the single printed positional tolerance; load_type 'Pallet ISO' from the stated 1200x1000 mm pallet with no 'Pallet EUR' claim; guidance 'None' / fleet_management_system 'Proprietary').

products.notes: PRINTED MODEL CODE: 'VNL14(V)-01' (p.7, folio 11-12). — TWO-MODEL PAGE: page 7 is a side-by-side configuration table for VNL14(V)-01 AND VNL16(V)-01. Only the payload (1400 vs 1600 kg) and the fork lift height (2924 vs 2844 mm) differ; weight (1350 kg), all overall dimensions, fork dimensions, speeds, accuracies, environment and battery rows are printed as merged single values covering both. Column assignment was verified against word x-coordinates (VNL14 header @ x=362 / VNL16 @ x=489 in the left table; VNL14 @ x=916 / VNL16 @ x=1066 in the right table) rather than reading order, because pdfplumber's linear text order interleaves the two tables. Note that the p.4 range-overview column 'L' quotes 2844 mm / 1600 kg — i.e. the VNL16 configuration — so p.4 must NOT be used as a cross-check for VNL14's lift height. If VNL16-01 is not yet in the DB it is a genuine additional variant on the same chassis. — AISLE WIDTH: 'Min. Stacking Aisle Width 2847 mm' taken (worst case for KO_IF_GT); the page also prints 'Min. Turning Aisle Width 2188 mm' (both for pallet 1200x1000 mm across forks widthwise). Both are merged values applying to VNL14 and VNL16. — STACKING_CAPABILITY LEFT NULL (deliberate, and the most consequential judgment on this product): the evidence is genuinely contradictory. Against: p.4 'Recommend Scenarios' row 'Indoor Material Stacking' is ticked ONLY for columns P and E, not for L. For: p.7 prints both 'Stacking Accuracy ±20mm/±1°' and a 'Min. Stacking Aisle Width', and the 2924 mm lift is physically sufficient to set a loaded EUR pallet (~1440 mm) on top of another; p.2 also advertises 'Multi-layer Stacking ... accurate stacking of more than six layers of goods' as a company capability without naming a series. Per industry README §6a ('Null if uncertain ...
